params.name: key
params.description: The key of the index to use.

params.name: section
params.description: The section of the index to use (e.g. 'Products').

params.name: item_id
params.description: The unique identifier of an item in the product catalog.

params.name: c
params.description: The ID of the client and version that the request is coming from, such as `cio-js-2.90`.

params.name: ui
params.description: A customer generated anonymized identifier for a user on a customer website. It should only be sent for logged in customers and helps Constructor to tie multiple client and session IDs together to form a behavioral data profile across devices.

params.name: fields
params.description: One or more product detail fields to include in the response. This parameter may be repeated to specify multiple fields.

params.name: s
params.description: An integer representing the users session number (starting with `1`), incremented after a 30 minute period of inactivity.

params.name: i
params.description: A globally unique identifier for the user browser (or mobile application instance) making the request.

items.docs: Retrieve product details for an item.
